PolicyProfile.description:
A containment policy for one protected asset. It is expressed entirely as two constraint limits,
applied to the scenario before SafeCut, EchoLab and ProofSeal run (halt/scenario/profiles.py):

- C-COVER: every enumerated path to the asset whose simulated risk is at least `cover_min_risk` must have
  a hard cut on its live route (0 = every enumerated path);
- C-RESIDUAL: the paths left open may together reach the asset in at most `residual_reach_limit`
  simulated rollouts (an upper bound: the sum of each open path's own reach count).
PolicyProfile.title: PolicyProfile

PolicyTradeoff.description:
What moving from one profile to the other costs and buys. Every number is a difference of the two
outcomes; every reason names the actions and paths it rests on.
PolicyTradeoff.title: PolicyTradeoff

PolicyWindow.description: A UTC window (e.g. a change freeze) during which the exception role must also approve.
PolicyWindow.title: PolicyWindow

ProfileOutcome.description: SafeCut's answer under one profile, with EchoLab's simulation of that answer.
ProfileOutcome.title: ProfileOutcome

ResidualRisk.description:
What a plan leaves open on the way to the protected asset, judged by its policy profile.

`reach_bound` sums each open path's own simulated reach count: an upper bound on the rollouts that can
still reach the asset through them (EchoLab's future C measures the actual count). Never a claim of zero
real-world risk: only enumerated paths in the modelled graph are counted.
ResidualRisk.title: ResidualRisk

Transition.description: EchoLab input: per rollout the hop succeeds with probability p after a uniform delay.
Transition.title: Transition

VariantInfo.description: A demo scenario variant: one changed input that shows the plan is derived, not scripted.
VariantInfo.title: VariantInfo

get.description:
Fast: while the service has not started, the failed start already says the database is down, so it
is not pinged again (an unreachable host can take seconds to time out).

SafeCut under every policy profile, each plan simulated by EchoLab, and the exact trade-off.
Read-only (nothing is stored or audited); 409 before correlation, like /paths.

post.description:
The demo's deterministic restart: baseline variant, replay from the start, no plan, no approvals.
Works after a failed restore. The audit log is append-only, so its history is kept (with this reset
recorded); everything derived afterwards is identical to a fresh start.
